artworks.title: Procession in the Sepulchre of Saint Medard(Procession dans les caveaux de St.Medard)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a procession of individuals moving towards the right. The figures are standing upright, some holding candles or objects close to their chests. Their facial features are not distinctly detailed. Most of the figures are wearing long, dark, heavy garments suitable for a cold climate, with head coverings. Bright highlights from the candles illuminate parts of their faces and clothing. The background has a textured design suggesting a dark, enclosed setting with no indication of open space.

artworks.title: View over Flat Country
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon, dominated by the sky. In the distance, there are rolling fields and clusters of vegetation. Two figures are depicted engaging in an activity, surrounded by shrubbery and trees. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, focusing on the intricate features of the trees and figures. The color palette consists of sepia and gray tones, giving the image a soft, muted quality.

artworks.title: Beggar with Crutches
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of an older seated man, facing right. He has distinct facial features, a full beard, and is bald with hair around the sides of his head. He is wearing loose clothing and holding a hat in his hands. The background is dimly lit with a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Two Mercenaries and a Woman
artworks.description: This image shows two knights in ornate armor standing in front of a large, gnarled tree with a skeletal figure holding an hourglass perched among its branches. In the background, there are mountains, a fortified village or castle next to a river, and a raven nearby. The tree is leafless and twisted. The ground has grass and small plants, and the sky has swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Josias Simler
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a long beard and mustache wearing a hat and a fur-trimmed garment. He appears serious and thoughtful. The background has a simple line border, and below the portrait is the text "IOSIAS SIMLERUS S.TEOLOGIAE PROFESSOR TIGURI."

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures around a reclining person who appears lifeless. The central figure has long, curly hair, closed eyes, and is dressed in a simple cloth. They are surrounded by three other figures, two of whom have halos. The surrounding figures show caring and somber expressions, with detailed garments. The background includes a large cross with inscriptions and a scroll draped over it.

artworks.title: Saint Maurice
artworks.medium: engraving, hand-colored in green, yellow, blue, and light brown
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with a slight contrapposto pose, holding a staff in their right hand and a spiked mace in their left. The person has short, curly hair, a halo, and is clad in armor with a billowing cloak. The background shows an outdoor setting with grass and hills or mountains in the distance under a cloudy sky. The image is framed by ornate lettering.

artworks.title: Apollo Dancing with the Nine Muses
artworks.description: The image shows nine full-body figures arranged in a circle, holding hands or touching shoulders. The figures are upright and wearing flowing garments. They have classical facial features and styled hair. The clothing consists of draped robes, togas, or tunics. The background is textured, emphasizing the figures' lines and attire. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Birth and Naming of John the Baptist
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene with two distinct panels. In the top panel, a figure is reclining in a bed, with a halo, while another haloed figure sits nearby, and a third figure tends to a cradle holding an infant. The bottom panel shows a seated figure writing in a book with an attentive audience of figures standing before him. The style resembles a medieval manuscript illumination, with vivid colors, gold accents, and intricate detailing on the garments and background. The painting uses an architectural framework motif to divide the two narrative scenes. The color palette includes deep reds, blues, and golds, and the background is patterned.

artworks.title: Praying Prophet
artworks.description: This is a painting of an alphabetic initial. The image features a decorated letter 'O' with rich colors and intricate designs, surrounded by a gold leaf background. The letter is composed of vines, foliage, shades of blue, green, pink, and gold, and bejeweled circular motifs. Inside the 'O', a robed figure is depicted, raising one hand. The use of gold and detailed patterns is indicative of illuminated manuscript illustrations typical of Medieval or Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Tree with Crown and Two Birds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, stylized tree with two birds perched on its branches. The artwork depicts a symmetrical design featuring a tree at the center with intricately rendered leaves and two birds facing each other. Above the tree is a cartouche containing a crest with geometric patterns, surrounded by decorative motifs. The bottom of the image includes some stylized text elements, though the text is hard to decipher and appears to be part of the decorative design. The piece is bordered with a patterned frame.

artworks.title: Two Putti with Shield Inscribed Pier Santi
artworks.description: The image shows an ornately designed emblem. It features a decorative emblem or coat of arms in a bordered frame, symbolically flanked by two winged cherub figures standing on either side of a central shield. The shield contains the initials "P S" and is crowned with an intricate floral ornament. Above the coat of arms is a depiction of a cherubic face with wide, outstretched wings. The border of the illustration is rich with floral and scroll details. At the bottom, the name "PIERSANTI" is inscribed. The style suggests a historical or heraldic representation often seen in emblem books or documents from past centuries.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated, full-body figure of a bearded man with exaggerated curly hair framing his face. He sits with his legs visible, draped in flowing robes that cover his torso and part of his legs, leaving his feet bare. His facial features are pronounced, including deep-set eyes and a full, curly beard. He holds a long, thin staff-like object in one hand while resting an open book in his lap with the other hand. A lamb is depicted resting in the folds of his robe. The man is set against a background with a radiating halo effect behind his head, creating a sense of illumination. The scene is filled with intricate details and textures.

artworks.title: View of Venice [upper left block]
artworks.medium: woodcut on two sheets of laid paper pasted together
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a city. The perspective is high above the city, showing its layout and architecture. Mountains are visible in the background, separating the sky from the water. Waves can be seen on the water and a ship is sailing. The city is depicted with detailed lines to show buildings, streets, and rivers. The color scheme is mainly black and white. The city appears densely built close to the viewer, with various structures, while farther away, the view is clearer. Personified representations of winds are in the upper corners.

artworks.title: View of Venice [upper center block]
artworks.medium: woodcut on two sheets of laid paper pasted together
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of the city of Venice. The city is divided by canals with tightly packed buildings. Mountains are visible in the background across water. A mythological figure with a trident is depicted in the clouds above the cityscape, with decorative script and the word "VENETIE" below. The map is detailed and linear in style, with a monochromatic color palette emphasizing the line work and textures. Islands, including Murano, are seen in the distance across the water, showcasing the layout of the city within its lagoon.

artworks.title: View of Venice [upper right block]
artworks.medium: woodcut on two sheets of laid paper pasted together
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing of a vast seascape from an elevated viewpoint, depicting the horizon, mountains, the sea with gentle waves, labeled buildings "TORCELLO" and "MURANO," as well as a cloud formation with a human face blowing wind labeled "AQUILO" and "FVLTRVVS." Two simplistic sailing vessels are visible on the water.

artworks.title: View of Venice [lower left block]
artworks.medium: woodcut on two sheets of laid paper pasted together
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a cityscape with waterways, detailed buildings, cloudy figures labeled "AFFRICVS," "AVSTER AFFRICVS," and "AVSTR," ships and boats on water, and a fine, monochrome color palette emphasizing details. The lines are intricate and precise, typical of engravings, conveying historical richness and complexity.

artworks.title: View of Venice [lower center block]
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a coastal city with a harbor filled with buildings and vessels. The city's skyline with various structures is visible in the distance. Detailed urban architecture is seen in the foreground, and the water is populated with boats. In the water, a muscular figure on a sea creature holds a trident. The image is created in a detailed etching or line engraving style with a monochrome color palette.

artworks.title: View of Venice [lower right block]
artworks.medium: woodcut on two sheets of laid paper pasted together
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial perspective of a coastal city with detailed ships in the water. The city has distinct structures along the horizon, small boats in the sea, and city walls with clustered buildings. The style is highly detailed and linear, resembling an engraved technique with fine lines for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing line work. A fanciful cloud formation is on the right, while the background shows the sky and sea expanding beyond the city.

artworks.title: Woman and Child with Distaff
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding a child. The woman is looking at the child, who is sitting on her arm. The woman's face has a calm expression, and she has an updo covered by a wrap. She is dressed in flowing garments, and she is holding a spindle with thread. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Man Kneeling
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and graphite
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a person shown from head to knees. The figure is kneeling with an upward gaze and head tilted back slightly. Facial features such as a bearded chin and relatively closed eyes are visible. The person is draped in a cloak or large garment, which covers most of the body and forms a rounded shape around the torso. The hands rest on the ground at either side, alongside bare feet. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Three Marys at the Tomb
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 44.6 × 29.3 cm (17 9/16 × 11 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures gathered around a radiant central figure emerging from a dark space. The figures wear flowing garments with intricate details, and the central figure emits light with stylized rays around its head. The spectators are in dynamic poses, and the background features a rocky structure.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an angelic figure and soldiers in a detailed composition, typical of religious iconography. The central angelic figure is bathed in light, situated near a cave. Soldiers are below, some bending down as if startled, with weapons strewn about. To the right, women in robes observe. The background includes rugged terrain, trees, and architecture. The use of shadows and highlights creates a dramatic ambiance.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Wise and Foolish Virgins
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an allegorical scene with figures and symbolic elements. The artwork has a complex composition, divided into distinct areas with various characters engaging in different activities. At the center, an angelic figure is positioned with a scroll, surrounded by clouds. Above, there are architectural elements resembling elaborate Gothic arches. To the left, a group of figures is involved in tasks related to work and craftsmanship. To the right, another group appears more idle, some in postures of dance or play. The overall composition suggests a narrative or moral story, potentially based on a biblical parable, with juxtaposition of virtuous labor against folly. The rendering and line work are characteristic of woodcuts or engravings, showcasing attention to detail and skilled use of shading to convey depth and texture, further enhanced by the intricate architectural elements and flowing drapery of the figures. The work conveys themes of moral duality and the dichotomy of virtue and vice, often explored during the period of its creation by artists like Pieter Bruegel the Elder.
